title: Group dynamics
learning_outcomes: Explain roles and norms in the context of group dynamics.
Compare and distinguish conformity in the context of group dynamics.
Apply facilitation in the context of group dynamics.
Evaluate and justify decisions about inclusion in the context of group dynamics.

lessons.title: Roles and norms
lessons.outcome: Explain roles and norms in the context of group dynamics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving roles and norms; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to meeting facilitation plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain roles and norms from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of roles and norms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Conformity
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish conformity in the context of group dynamics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving conformity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to meeting facilitation plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain conformity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of conformity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Facilitation
lessons.outcome: Apply facilitation in the context of group dynamics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving facilitation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to meeting facilitation plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain facilitation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of facilitation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Inclusion
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about inclusion in the context of group dynamics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving inclusion; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to meeting facilitation plan.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain inclusion from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of inclusion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of roles and norms; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of conformity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of facilitation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of inclusion; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
